works.author: Bato UI/UX
works.comment: 深色 AI 创作平台 Loopie：一句“What will you create today?”配提示词输入框，下方最近作品网格一字排开，笔记本浮在水面圆台上，动效感扑面而来；AI 创作工具用“一个问题 + 一排作品”把“开口就能做图”讲得轻松直接。
works.comment_en: Loopie, a dark AI creative platform: one “What will you create today?” prompt box above a row of recent creations, the laptop floating on a watery podium; one question and one row of work make “just ask and it creates” feel effortless.
works.title: Loopie – AI Creative Platform | Dark Mode & Motion Design

works.author: Halo Product
works.comment: AI 数字人外观定制 Litlow：发型、发色、发长三组控件围着 3D 形象排开，右侧六张预设头像一键切换，还能试听声音、导出 GLB/FBX；AI 形象工具用“一组滑杆 + 六张预设”把捏脸做得像选衣服一样简单。
works.comment_en: Litlow, an AI avatar customizer: hairstyle, hair color and hair length controls ring a 3D figure, with six presets to switch in one tap, plus voice preview and GLB/FBX export; a few sliders and six presets make shaping a digital face as easy as picking an outfit.
works.title: UI-UX for an AI Product ✦ Litlow

works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto
works.comment: AI 工作流自动化平台网站：黑底上“One Platform. Endless Automation.”大标题镇场，下方节点连线图把复杂流程画成一张网，绿色点缀提亮深色界面；自动化产品用“一句口号 + 一张流程网”把“串起所有工具”说得干净有力。
works.comment_en: An AI workflow automation platform site: “One Platform. Endless Automation.” headlines a black page, with a node-and-line diagram turning tangled processes into one clear web, green accents lifting the dark interface; one slogan and one workflow web make “connect every tool” sound clean and strong.
works.title: AI Workflow Automation Platform UI/UX & SaaS Website Animation

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa
works.comment: 医疗诊所着陆页 Vitalis Care：两人灿烂笑脸的大图上压着“live healthier.”超大字，Est. 2018 一行小字透着老牌诊所的底气；健康品牌用“一张笑脸 + 一句口号”把看病这件事讲得温暖可亲。
works.comment_en: Vitalis Care, a healthcare clinic landing page: two beaming faces under a giant “live healthier.”, with a quiet “Est. 2018” lending old-clinic credibility; one smiling photo and one slogan make visiting the doctor feel warm and welcoming.
works.title: Vitalis Care - Healthcare Clinic Landing Page Animtion

works.author: Artspire
works.comment: VPN 移动 App：紫色小章鱼吉祥物趴在流量数字上，“Tap to connect”一键连接，左下角“秘密位置”卡片亮出纽约 IP；工具类 App 用“一个吉祥物 + 一个大按钮”把枯燥的 VPN 做得俏皮好记。
works.comment_en: A VPN mobile app: a purple octopus mascot sits on the data allowance, one big “Tap to connect” button does the job, and a “secret location” card shows the New York IP; one mascot and one button make a dry VPN playful and memorable.
works.title: VPN Mobile App UI/UX Design

works.author: Awe Mobile App
works.comment: 营养与健康饮食追踪 App：三屏手机并排——果汁食谱、剩余 1,300 大卡、配料清单与 Dietly AI 建议，大号卡路里数字配暖黄点缀；饮食工具用“一个大数字 + 一条 AI 建议”把“今天还能吃什么”算得明明白白。
works.comment_en: A nutrition and meal-tracking app: three phone screens side by side — a juice recipe, 1,300 kcal remaining, an ingredient list and a Dietly AI suggestion — with a giant calorie figure warmed by amber accents; one big number and one AI tip make “what can I still eat today” perfectly clear.
works.title: Nutrition & Healthy Meal Tracking App

works.author: Mahmudul Hasan Manik
works.comment: 教育管理系统 Edaca（阿拉伯语 RTL 界面）：绿色底上一部手机，学生、课程与缴费数据配一幅小图表排得疏密有致；教育 SaaS 用“一部手机 + 一组学校数据”把一所学校的运转收进掌心，RTL 排版也值得借鉴。
works.comment_en: Edaca, an education management system with an Arabic RTL interface: on a green backdrop, one phone holds students, courses and payment data around a small chart; one phone and one set of school data fit a whole school in your palm, and the RTL layout itself is worth studying.
works.title: Edaca - Education Management System | إيداكا - نظام إدارة التعلي
